features.title: Programmatic runner session embedding via openSession API
acceptance: External test runners (Pytest, Vitest, Playwright) can embed an e2e session using open_session() with custom target, working directory, and step progress callback
Session manages complete fixture graph (agent, app, screen, device, network) with idempotent cleanup on exit
Secret redaction filter scrubs credentials, API keys, and authorization headers from logs and step artifacts
REST API exposes full session lifecycle: creation, step execution, telemetry collection, and trace export

features.title: Agentic multimodal assertion grounding and semantic locator hierarchy
acceptance: Accessibility tree parser ranks candidate elements using deterministic role and name heuristics offline
Opt-in multi-provider LLM adapter supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Ollama with error redaction
Visual difference scoring detects UI regressions and layout shifts across session checkpoints

features.title: Deterministic replay telemetry and AI/ML locator benchmark suite
acceptance: Deterministic test replay reconstructs session step timelines and artifact bundles
Reproducible benchmark measures semantic locator accuracy vs baseline fuzzy matching across labeled UI workflows

features.title: Keycloak OIDC authentication and upstream SAML IdP broker
acceptance: PKCE authorization code flow with state validation and JWKS token verification
Role-based access control rejecting unauthenticated and unauthorized requests
Production startup safety refusing local demo mode in production environments
